segments.title: 第178章 元旦倒計時
segments.content:
Chapter 178: New Year's Day Countdown

The bonfire party at Fu Yi High, amidst Yan Zhusheng's resounding song, reached its climax.

After the song ended, the bonfire party came to a final close with the entire school singing the school anthem together.

The principal went on stage to give some concluding remarks and blessings, announcing the successful conclusion of the party.

Afterward, under the guidance of the Dean of Students' microphone, everyone left the basketball court in an orderly fashion, class by class, carrying their chairs.

On the way back to the classroom, Kong Junxiang and Ding Xiang were surrounded by the students of Class 8.

As they were about to head up into the academic building, Kong Junxiang remembered something and suddenly asked Ding Xiang curiously, "By the way, where did you get this thing you gave me?"

"Hm? This?" Being asked this, Ding Xiang's gaze roamed through the crowd of Class 8 students, finally landing on Yan Zhusheng. "I have Student Yan Zhusheng to thank for that. She gave it to me on the spot."

"Yan Zhusheng gave it to you?" Kong Junxiang was a little surprised. He turned his head to look at Yan Zhusheng in the group and couldn't help but ask, "Yan Zhusheng, where did you get this?"

Yan Zhusheng, suddenly called upon, blinked her eyes and pointed towards the flowerbed they had just passed by the academic building, answering, "I got it from there."

"Huh?" Kong Junxiang, Ding Xiang, and the other students all turned their heads to look in the direction Yan Zhusheng was pointing.

Zhang Guohuang even went right up to the edge of the flowerbed and exclaimed, "Holy crap, it's true! There are even marks where it was dug up."

At this, Kong Junxiang fell completely silent.

He glanced at the bright sign next to the flowerbed that read, "A flower may be small, but its life is precious. Cherish and care for it, and share in its beauty."

In the bottom right corner of the sign, as if afraid someone might not understand, were four small words: Please do not pick.

"Can't you see that sign?" The corner of Kong Junxiang's mouth twitched, not quite knowing what to say.

Yan Zhusheng blinked and confessed honestly, "I said the same thing, but Li Luo said that while a flower's life is precious, it's not more precious than a person's life. Desperate times call for desperate measures, and we can make up for it later."

Kong Junxiang looked at Li Luo, only to see the boy whistling, pretending not to have heard as he carried his chair into the academic building.

Teacher Ding covered her mouth and giggled softly.

The other students also snickered, all feeling this was very much in line with the class president's style of doing things.

"Stop laughing and hurry back to the classroom," Li Luo called out to the group. "Don't block the classes behind us."

"Heh." Kong Junxiang chuckled and shook his head, heading upstairs. "I can't believe you thought of that, even making Yan Zhusheng dig up the flowerbed. Why didn't you do it yourself?"

"Teacher Kong, that's a bit unfair of you to say," Li Luo said with a speechless look. "I was backstage drumming for you. Otherwise, how would you have smoothly transitioned into the chorus? I've been worrying myself sick over your lifelong happiness here."

As soon as he said this, Kong Junxiang stopped talking. After a cough, he quickened his pace upstairs.

Ding Xiang's gaze towards Li Luo, however, grew increasingly gentle. The more she looked at Li Luo, the more pleased she was, feeling happy that Kong Junxiang had such a class president.

Thinking back to how she used to deliberately call on Li Luo, amazed and suspicious of his incredible memory and ability to multitask, she couldn't help but chuckle and shake her head.

Perhaps there really were such outstanding young people in this world.

To be honest, while top students like Ying Chanxi were truly formidable academically, Ding Xiang had seen such prodigies before.

But for someone like Li Luo, who not only excelled in his studies but also possessed the emotional intelligence for handling people and matters, along with a humorous and witty way of speaking, to appear in a fifteen or sixteen-year-old was indeed a very rare situation.

Even though Li Luo was currently ranked 15th, with 14 people ahead of him in terms of grades, Ding Xiang had a very distinct premonition.

In the future, Li Luo's personal achievements would surely be the highest among this batch of students.

After returning to the classroom, everyone put their chairs back at their own seats, and then, under the teacher's direction, entered a period of self-study and rest.

Once all the teachers and students in the school had safely returned to their classrooms and a headcount was confirmed, the Dean of Students announced over the broadcast that school was dismissed, and wished everyone a happy New Year's Day in advance.

At nine o'clock in the evening, Fu Yi High began its holiday.

Of course, boarding students who didn't have parents to pick them up still had to spend one more night in the dorms and could only leave the school the next morning.

The rest went to their respective homes and could begin enjoying the New Year's Day holiday.

"You're staying at the dorm tonight?"

Li Luo packed his schoolbag and waited in the classroom for Ying Chanxi to come downstairs to find him, so he made some small talk with Yan Zhusheng.

"Yeah," Yan Zhusheng nodded. "Mom is very busy, so she definitely won't have time to pick me up. I'll go home tomorrow morning."

"Will Auntie Yuan come back to spend New Year's Day with you?" Li Luo asked.

Yan Zhusheng shook her head. "New Year's Day is the busiest time. There will be a lot of events to attend."

"I see." Li Luo thought for a moment. "Then don't go home tomorrow morning. Come to our place first. Have lunch with us before you go. Xixi and I are heading back in the afternoon."

Hearing this, Yan Zhusheng's eyes lit up slightly, and she nodded. "Oh, okay."

Then she took out her phone and sent a message to the cook in advance, telling her she didn't need to come and make lunch tomorrow.

Perhaps it was because she saw a message from Yuan Wanqing when she opened her phone, but after putting her phone away, Yan Zhusheng said to Li Luo, "My mom wants me to remind you that tomorrow, New Year's Day, is when the exclusive interview goes live."

"The Wen Yue Group seems to be releasing the interview video in the early morning. My mom said she'll post about it on Weibo at midnight, then repost it again at noon, and reply to comments in the evening."

"She said to remind you to ask the Wen Yue Group if they want to get you a verified author tag on Weibo, so you can interact in the comments then too."

After listening, Li Luo nodded in understanding. "Please tell your mom thank you for me."

"You're welcome."

Just as the two finished their conversation, Ying Chanxi appeared at the back door of the Class 8 classroom and called out to Li Luo.

Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng stood up together and went downstairs with Ying Chanxi.

"Auntie Lin said to come home for dinner tomorrow night, don't forget," Ying Chanxi reminded him as they went downstairs.

Li Luo nodded and then told her about inviting Yan Zhusheng over for lunch tomorrow.

"Great!" Ying Chanxi smiled and hugged Yan Zhusheng's arm. "It's a shame the school is so strict, otherwise you could have just stayed at our place for the night, Zhusheng."

"It's not entirely impossible," Li Luo thought for a moment. "I saw that Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang didn't have parents picking them up, and they were planning to sneak home tonight."

"Mmm…" Hearing him say that, Ying Chanxi shook her head. "It's better not to. After all, it's a school rule. It would be bad if you got caught."

"It's okay, I'll go to your place tomorrow morning," Yan Zhusheng said.

So Ying Chanxi happily continued to hug Yan Zhusheng's arm, complimenting her on how wonderful her performance on stage was today.

Yan Zhusheng also happily accepted the praise, her heart filled with anticipation for having a meal at their home tomorrow.

After going downstairs, the three of them met up with Xu Youyu. They walked out of the school gates together, where Yan Zhusheng bid them farewell and headed towards the dormitory area across the street.

Li Luo and the other two returned to Bihai Lanting, apartment 1502.

On the way back, Li Luo told Xu Youyu about tomorrow's arrangements again and then asked what she thought.

"Then I'll join you guys for lunch tomorrow too," Xu Youyu said with a smile. "I'll go home for a free meal in the evening."

Her home was in the Qianjiang University faculty housing, just a short walk away, so she could go back whenever she wanted.

But she probably would only go home for a day or two before sneaking back.

Otherwise, her parents would definitely nag her every day.

Back at home.

Li Luo quickly washed up, then sat down at his computer and checked his QQ.

As expected, his editor had sent him a message during the day.

Qian Zhou: [Video]

Qian Zhou: This is the video of the interview. Your face has been censored in post-production, and your voice has been altered. I guarantee no one will recognize you.

Qian Zhou: And this is the specific schedule for the event.

Qian Zhou: [Image]

Qian Zhou: If you're willing, we've also discussed it with Yuan Wanqing. We can help you quickly get verified on Weibo. After the event goes live tomorrow, you can interact with her in the comments.

Qian Zhou: It's really up to you.

Qian Zhou: Then, at midnight, your book will also be uploaded to all channels. Basically, any website affiliated with the Wen Yue Group will be able to find your book.

Qian Zhou: Whether it can truly take off all depends on this push.

After reading the editor's messages, Li Luo watched the video and, confirming that it was impossible to tell that "Chong Ran" was him, he nodded in relief.

Then he clicked on the image and carefully examined the specific event schedule.

According to the Wen Yue Group's plan, besides extensive promotion on Weibo and other major platforms, there would also be a corresponding reading event on the Qidian Reading app, prepared specifically for "I'm Really Not a Star."

After all, this was the first time the Wen Yue Group had used this method to link and promote a book with a celebrity.

If the results were good this time, it might open up a new way of thinking and a new direction for promotion and marketing for the Wen Yue Group.

According to the image Qian Zhou sent, the reading event on the main site alone included exposure spots like the app's splash screen push, promotion on the event page, and recommendations via small icons on the bookshelf.

It was safe to say the traffic would be maxed out.

Under these circumstances, Li Luo wasn't planning to hold back anymore.

He directly set it to release one chapter every half hour, non-stop for the entire 24 hours.

He would give his dear readers a huge surprise.

And also put some pressure on the other authors on the site.

Just as Li Luo finished with these matters, Ying Chanxi, who had just finished showering, knocked on the door and walked into his bedroom, asking him with an expectant look, "Do you want to stay up late tonight? How about we see the new year in together?"

(End of this chapter)
